 Nagaland Dear Lottery Result Today 31-10-2026 1 PM 6 PM 8 PM | Lottery Sambad LIVE; Full Winners List Here
 News oi-Pooja Jaiswar By Pooja Jaiswar 
 Updated: Saturday, October 31, 2026, 14:06 [IST]
 Add as a preferred source on Google The Nagaland state is declaring its three Dear Saturday weekly lotteries on October 31, 2026, scheduled at 1PM, 6PM and 8PM. These lotteries are held on a daily basis at P. R. Hill Junction, Kohima - 797001 and are officially managed by the Director of Nagaland State Lotteries. The draws are multiple, called Dear Morning 1PM, Dear Day or Dear Evening 6PM and Dear Night 8PM. Each of these lotteries offers Rs 1 crore prize money.
 Nagaland Dear Lottery Result Today 31-10-2026 1 PM 6 PM 8 PM | Lottery Sambad LIVE; Prize Structures
 The Dear 1PM Morning lottery is also called as the Dear Vision Morning 1PM lotter, while the Dear 6PM lottery is referred as Dear Elite and Dear Lucky. All these lotteries offer a total of seven prizes.
 The first prize winner will get Rs 1 crore, while the second prize winners will get Rs 9,000. The third prize winners will get Rs 500, followed by 4th and 5th prizes of Rs 250 and Rs 120. There are consolation prize of Rs 1,000 as well.
 The live draw begins at the schedule at 1PM, 6PM, and 8PM, while the results PDF will be out by 1:10PM, 6:10PM, and 8:10PM.
